title: Usage plans and invoices in Prospectus; no free tier, no seats
description:
What: define plans as usage prices in the Prospectus plan catalogue (profiles, plans, billing lines), with custom domains included. Meter events from Papyrus become billing lines. Coordinate with the Prospectus session; its approval is needed for Prospectus changes.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Usage becomes a priced line
  Given a month of metered usage
  When the invoice is prepared
  Then lines show usage times price and no per-seat charge
